Below is a quick snapshot of the **federal Canadian holidays** that fall on a **Friday or Monday** in 2023 – the dates that automatically create a 3‑day “long weekend” without needing to take an extra day off. (If you’re interested in provincial holidays or want to see which holidays fall on a Thursday/Tuesday so you could add a day off, let me know!)

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | (No long weekend) |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Creates a long weekend in those provinces |
| **February 20** | Monday | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Creates a long weekend in Manitoba |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday | Creates a long weekend nationwide |
| **April 7** | Monday | Victoria Day | Creates a long weekend nationwide |
| **May 22** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (BC, Yukon) | Creates a long weekend in those provinces |
| **June 19** | Monday | Canada Day | Creates a long weekend nationwide |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day (observed July 2 in most provinces) | (No long weekend) |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | Creates a long weekend nationwide |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving | Creates a long weekend nationwide |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day | Creates a long weekend nationwide |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Creates a long weekend nationwide |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | (No long weekend) |

### How to pull this data yourself

If you’d like to generate this list programmatically (or extend it to provincial holidays), the `holidays` Python package makes it easy:

```bash
pip install holidays
```

```python
import holidays
from datetime import date

canada_holidays = holidays.Canada(years=2023)

long_weekends = []
for d, name in canada_holidays.items():
    if d.weekday() == 0 or d.weekday() == 4:   # Monday (0) or Friday (4)
        long_weekends.append((d, name))

print(long_weekends)
```

This will return a list of tuples `(date, holiday_name)` for all federal holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday in 2023. If you want to include provincial holidays, you can instantiate `holidays.Canada(provinces=['ON', 'BC', ...], years=2023)` with the desired province codes.

Let me know if you’d like the full list including provincial holidays or if you need help integrating this into your app!
